editorial:
Imagine being a tired Civil War soldier who suddenly wakes up on Mars, surrounded by giant green aliens and ancient cities. That's the wild ride you get with John Carter, a big-budget sci-fi adventure that mixes old-school pulp storytelling with modern special effects. You follow Carter as he jumps across the red planet, discovers he has superhuman strength in the lower gravity, and gets pulled into a war between rival kingdoms. The world of Barsoom feels huge and strange, with flying ships, four-armed warriors, and a princess who refuses to be saved. It's a movie that wants to sweep you away with pure spectacle and heart.

The action scenes are a blast, especially when Carter leaps into battle and takes on entire armies. The visuals hold up well, and the creature designs are genuinely cool. On the downside, the story can feel overstuffed, with too many names and factions to keep track of, and the pacing drags in the middle. Still, if you enjoy grand adventure movies with a classic hero's journey, you'll have a good time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for top picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Carter discovers the Therns, shape-shifting beings manipulating Barsoom's wars, and stops their plan. He marries Dejah Thoris and seems to settle on Mars, but a Thern sends him back to Earth. Years later, Carter fakes his death to lure the Thern, kills him, and uses the medallion to return to Barsoom. The twist reveals he never truly left his heart behind, and he finally reunites with Dejah on Mars.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves grand sci-fi adventures and classic hero stories.
